invoked_as: Agent (general-purpose), by AS6: a first reader, then a second fresh reader for the fixes.
ran_by: Sub-agents; the reviewers wrote none of the code they read.
scope: d9ea6fb (v0.1.33) to bc08ae5: the panel no longer shows a stale 'no run pass is saved' line beside a saved pass; the AI-helper note clears when the helper answers; two lands of one Drive file name create one file; an 'I placed these by hand' panel button clears exactly the shown needs-you days and marks them landed. About 35 program lines, written by AS6 (accepted by Kartaan Control).

found.finding: The clear ask cleared whatever was on the list at click time, not the days the panel showed.
found.fix: The panel sends the exact days; only those are cleared; a check that a later day stays.

found.finding: The ask could cross with a running night's own writes to the same lists.
found.fix: Refused while a run is going; check added.

found.finding: The 5-minute memory of a put file could count a file the seller had since deleted or put in the bin.
found.fix: The remembered id is checked with Drive (trashed or gone = not counted); check added for a binned file.

found.finding: Unpruned maps; a lost space in 'Kartaan, <when>'.
found.fix: Space restored; the unproven prune and a never-read size removed.

found.finding: 17 changes no check noticed (button wiring lines, dead lines).
found.fix: Checks added for each wiring line and shown red when the line is removed; dead lines removed.

found.finding: The queue key is report + file name while the memory key is folder + file name; a run starting between the 'run going' check and the write could cross.
found.why: Two reports never share a folder and file name; the crossing window is milliseconds and loses at worst a noise entry.

known_gaps: Why two claims files were written 15 s apart was not proven; the fix removes the cause visible in the code (list-then-put with no waiting, listing lag).
